# National Grid continues holiday tradition of giving by decorating Ronald McDonald House in Albany


- [Home](https://www.nationalgrid.com/)
- [News](https://www.nationalgrid.com/news)


23rd November 2026


*News*


For more than a decade, National Grid employees have volunteered their time to decorate the Ronald McDonald House, helping create a warm holiday atmosphere for families with children receiving medical treatment far from home. In addition to decorating, National Grid employees have contributed thousands of dollars in personal donations to support Ronald McDonald House Albany.


“For many years, National Grid has been dedicated to deliver holiday cheer to the families who are staying at the Ronald McDonald House during what is often one of the most difficult times in their lives,” said National Grid Regional Executive Kimberly Ireland. “There is something truly special about this tradition and it’s one of our favorite volunteer activities of the year. It allows us to come together as employees outside of the office and off the truck to help create a brighter holiday season.”


National Grid provided 1,000 feet of lights, with 3,000 LED bulbs that cover the large tree on the balcony, three houses, and a large wreath around the organization’s sign. In addition, approximately 40 pine boughs decorate the house. Ellm’s Farms and Bob’s Trees contributed to decorations that are on display. As part of the day, the tree was set on the balcony by one of National Grid’s bucket trucks.


“The company has been helping decorate the Ronald McDonald House for many years, and seeing the families in residence as well as area neighbors enjoy the lights and decorations makes this project especially meaningful,” said Ireland. “While National Grid is a large utility company, our employees live and work in the communities we serve. Being able to help brighten the holidays for families during a difficult time is something we take great pride in.”


In addition to the Ronald McDonald House Albany, for several years crews have also decorated the Ronald McDonald House Family Retreat. The Family Retreat is located at Krantz Cottage in Lake George, NY, and provides a peaceful and supportive setting where families experiencing serious childhood illness can enjoy being together, making memories.


“National Grid's holiday decorating is a very special tradition here at the Ronald McDonald House,” said Kimmy Venter, CEO of Ronald McDonald House Albany. “Each year the lights, tree and greenery bring joy to children and families who are spending the holidays away from home while receiving medical care. We are deeply grateful for National Grid's ongoing generosity and volunteer support.”


Ronald McDonald House Albany provides a home away from home, free of charge, for families with children receiving medical treatment in the Capital Region. The annual decorating effort helps create a welcoming and festive environment during the holiday season for families facing serious medical challenges.
